idea: Items can be cut into pieces. Rank them by value per unit of weight, take the best first, and a piece of the next one to fill the bag exactly. The greedy choice is provably the best.
time: O(n log n) for the sort
useWhen: The things you pack can be divided: liquids, grains, time
A quick, provably optimal plan is needed
avoidWhen: Items must be taken whole or not at all (use 0/1 knapsack): this plan may split an item
